name: Pornhub
author: quarry
description: Pornhub as itself: its orderings, its own list of categories down the rail, and a watch screen that resolves the page to real files and keeps going with what is next. One site, all of it — the Tube lens covers three sites shallowly, this covers one properly.

skins.name: Orange
skins.description: The site's own shape: black ground, orange on the things you press, posters big enough to choose from.
